text:
sam: Quick PRD intake — per-tenant minimum-quality + rollback triggers.
sam: Problem: when we route tenants to cheaper/quantized variants we see intermittent quality regressions; customers expect predictable behavior and a clear contract.
sam: Goals: 1) define minimum eval metrics per-tenant (semantic-similarity / task-specific) + tolerance bands, 2) automatic rollback triggers + manual escalation path, 3) rollout plan and guardrails for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
sam: Non-goals: not reworking model selection heuristics today, not inventing new evaluation metrics (research will pick concrete metrics).
sam: Success metrics: detection within X mins, mean time to rollback, false-positive rollback rate < 5%.
sam: Sketch ACs below — want quick sanity check before I draft PRD.
maria: Sounds good. Can we scope initial ACs to embedding-similarity (cosine) + customer-provided golden-sets? Need a way for tenants to attach threshold + owner contact in the Console.
ashley: From infra/serving perspective we need clear API surface. Suggest exposing per-tenant config: quality_gate { threshold, window_mins, min_samples, fallback_model_id, notify_channels }
ashley: Example config block:
```
quality_gate: {
  threshold: 0.88,
  window_mins: 30,
  min_samples: 50,
  fallback: "llama-quant-v2",
  notify: ["oncall", "tenant-owner"]
}
```
devon: Edge cases to call out: low-volume tenants (stat noise), cold-start (no baseline), label drift when customer updates their data, and adversarial inputs that skew metrics. Recommend min_samples + smoothing window.
erin: Console UX: show current threshold, recent metric timeseries, and a "simulate rollback" button that previews traffic split and estimated cost/latency change. We can wire a small mock for the PRD.
sam: Rollout plan: opt-in beta -> internal tenants -> canary 5% traffic -> ramp to 25% if metrics stable. Evaluation window 2 weeks per phase.
sam: Acceptance criteria (proposal): detection precision >= 0.9 on internal eval sets; rollback latency (time from trigger to fallback serving) <= 10m; false rollback rate < 5%.
pr-review-bot: PRD checklist reminder: include owner, success metrics, ACs, rollout plan, test plan, and a migration story. Template: https://redwood.internal/prd-templates/quality-gate
maria: I'll draft the PRD by EOD Wed and include console mocks. tagging @ashley @devon for API + metric ACs.
ashley: :thumbsup: I'll file an RFC for the API schema and include a compatibility/migration path for existing tenant configs.
devon: Also add a metric for "false rollback impact" — percent of fallback requests that actually decrease the tenant's key metric by > delta; we should keep that < 2% ideally.
sam: Great. Marking as intake and scheduling a short sync Wed 10am to review draft. Thanks all.
